name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fixes TV shows losing their episodes: when a friend's Jellyfin found TVDB/TMDB ids for its shows, every show, season and episode was deleted and recreated here, losing watched state. Titles now keep their identity. Syncs no longer rewrite every synced item in the Jellyfin database each time, which made large libraries slow, and friend libraries are paged in a stable order so episodes with identical names can't be skipped. New: the Libraries tab shows a sync status per friend library - what will be downloaded before anything is, progress, and plain-language errors - and Refresh now runs in the background. Update both servers.
